issues.claim: What is easier for a team right now - following your guideline or working around it? And who actually makes the decisions about a service?
issues.problem: The hint names both pillars of the answer (make the recommended way easiest, and decision ownership with the team) almost directly, so it is a little stronger than a nudge. The Russian hint matches it. The meaning is the same in both languages.
issues.suggestedFix: Keep only one nudge, for example: "Why would a team choose to work around a guideline, and who owns the decision about their service?" Apply the same change to locales.ru.hint.
